data.summary: This directory contains tabular data schemas in CSV format representing an e-commerce domain model, including customers, products, orders, and order items. These files serve as a data layer or dataset fixture for database seeding or analytics.

file_insights.name: customers.csv
file_insights.summary: CSV schema definition for customer records.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains CSV header fields: customer_id, name, city, membership_tier, updated_at.
file_insights.detailed_description: Defines the schema for customer data records, containing identifiers, names, cities, membership tiers, and timestamps.
responsibilities: Track membership tiers and geographic location

file_insights.name: order_items.csv
file_insights.summary: CSV schema definition for order items.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains CSV header fields: order_item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, updated_at.
file_insights.detailed_description: Defines the schema for order line items, mapping products to orders with quantities and unit prices.
responsibilities: Track quantities and pricing per item

file_insights.name: orders.csv
file_insights.source_summary: Contains CSV header fields: order_id, customer_id, order_status, ordered_at, updated_at.
file_insights.detailed_description: Defines the schema for customer orders, tracking order status and timestamps.

file_insights.name: products.csv
file_insights.summary: CSV schema and sample data for products.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains CSV headers and sample product records including product_id, name, category, price, and updated_at.
file_insights.detailed_description: Defines the product catalog data schema, including pricing, categories, and inventory update timestamps.
